camel_example: aliyun hbase DescribeInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-4f51d54g50000' --PageNumber 1 --ClusterId 'hb-bp1u0639js2h70000' --Tag.1.Value value --ClusterName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DbType hbase
description_en: Queries the list of ApsaraDB for HBase instances in a specified region by calling DescribeInstances
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstances查询指定地域的HBase实例列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun hbase describe-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --db-type hbase --cluster-name test --cluster-id hb-bp1u0639js2h70000 --resource-group-id rg-4f51d54g50000 --tag Value=value Key=key --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html to query the region ID.

If you specify the Tag.N.Key and Tag.N.Value parameters, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html接口获取。

调用本接口时，如果传入了Tag.N.Key和Tag.N.Value参数，则本参数必须传入
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the instance list. The minimum value is 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 实例列表的页码，起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of rows to display per page. The maximum value is 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多可显示的行数，最大值为100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The service type. Valid values:
hbase: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition or ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition (Standalone).
hbaseue: ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition.
bds: BDS data synchronization service
parameters.help_zh:
服务类型，取值：
hbase：HBase标准版或HBase单机版。
hbaseue：HBase增强版。
bds：表示BDS数据同步服务
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the ApsaraDB for HBase instance
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can query the resource group ID in the Resource Management console
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，可通过资源组控制台查询
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key and tag value form a key-value pair in the format {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}
fields.help_zh: 标签的键，与Tag Value组成标签的键值对，格式为{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value and tag key form a key-value pair
fields.help_zh: 标签键的值，与Tag Key组成标签的键值对
fields.name: value

Instance.description_en: The list of ApsaraDB for HBase instances

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Manual renewal is used.

This parameter is returned only when the billing method of the instance is subscription
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
实例是否自动续费，返回值：

true：自动续费。
false：手动续费。

仅当实例的付费类型为包年包月才会返回本参数

BackupStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup feature is supported. Valid values:

open: The backup feature is supported.
close: The backup feature is not supported
BackupStatus.description_zh:
表示是否支持备份功能，返回值：

open：支持备份功能。
close：不支持备份功能

ClusterType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

cluster: Cluster Edition.
single: single node
ClusterType.description_zh:
实例类型，返回值：

cluster：集群版。
single：单节点

ColdStorageStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether cold storage is supported. Valid values:

open: Cold storage is supported.
close: Cold storage is not supported
ColdStorageStatus.description_zh:
是否支持冷存储功能，返回值：

open：支持冷存储功能。
close：不支持冷存储功能

CoreDiskCount.description_en: The number of core cloud disks

CoreDiskSize.description_en: The disk capacity of the core node, in GB by default
CoreDiskSize.description_zh: Core节点磁盘容量，默认单位G

CoreDiskType.description_en:
The disk type of the core node. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
local_hdd: local HDD.
local__ssd: local SSD
CoreDiskType.description_zh:
Core节点磁盘类型，返回值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
local_hdd：本地HDD盘。
local__ssd：本地SSD盘

CoreInstanceType.description_en: The node specifications of the core node

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created, in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss
CreatedTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

CreatedTimeUTC.description_en: The time when the instance was created, in UTC

Duration.description_en:
The Unified Auto Renewal Cycle. Valid values:
Monthly purchase: The auto-renewal epoch is one month.
Annual purchase: The auto-renewal epoch is one year (12 months).

This parameter is returned only when the billing method of the instance is subscription
Duration.description_zh:
自动续费周期，返回值：
按月购买：则自动续费周期为1个月。
按年购买：则自动续费周期为1年（12个月）。

仅当实例的付费类型为包年包月才会返回本参数

Engine.description_en:
The data engine type. Valid values:

hbase: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition or ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition (Standalone).
hbaseue: ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition.
serverlesshbase: ApsaraDB for HBase Serverless Edition.
bds: BDS instance
Engine.description_zh:
数据引擎类型，返回值：

hbase：HBase标准版或HBase单机版。
hbaseue：HBase增强版。
serverlesshbase：HBaseServerless版。
bds：表示BDS实例

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires, in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例到期时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

ExpireTimeUTC.description_en: The time when the instance expires, in UTC format

IsDeletionProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled. Valid values:

true: Deletion protection is enabled.
false: Deletion protection is not enabled
IsDeletionProtection.description_zh:
是否开启删除保护，返回值：

true：已开启。
false：未开启

IsHa.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is configured for high availability. Valid values:

true: The instance is configured for high availability.
false: The instance is not configured for high availability.

Cluster Edition instances use the default configurations for high availability and use two master nodes. Single-node instances use the actual active capacity
IsHa.description_zh:
实例是否配置为高可用，返回值：

true：配置为高可用。
false：未配置为高可用。

集群版默认配置为高可用，使用2个Master节点。单节点配置为实际可用容量

MasterDiskSize.description_en: The disk capacity of the master node, in GB by default
MasterDiskSize.description_zh: Master节点的磁盘容量，默认单位G

MasterDiskType.description_en:
The disk type of the master node. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

This parameter is returned for single-node instances
MasterDiskType.description_zh:
Master节点的磁盘类型，返回值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。

单节点实例会返回此参数

MasterInstanceType.description_en: The node specifications of the master node

MasterNodeCount.description_en:
The master node type. Valid values:

0: The master node is a single node.
2: The master node uses Cluster Edition
MasterNodeCount.description_zh:
表示Master节点类型，返回值：

0表示Master节点为单节点。
2表示Master节点为集群版

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values:

VPC: VPC network. If the network type is VPC, the VswitchId and VpcId parameters are returned.
CLASSIC: classic network
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型，返回值：

VPC：专有网络类型，如果为专有网络，就会返回VswitchId和VpcId参数。
CLASSIC：经典网络类型

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
实例的计费类型，返回值：

Prepaid：包年包月。
Postpaid：按量付费

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

CREATING: The instance is being created.
ACTIVATION: The instance is running.
DELETING: The instance is being deleted.
RESTARTING: The instance is being restarted.
MINOR_VERSION_TRANSING: The instance is undergoing a minor version upgrade
Status.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值：

CREATING：创建中。
ACTIVATION：运行中。
DELETING：删除中。
RESTARTING：重启中。
MINOR_VERSION_TRANSING：小版本升级中

VpcId.description_en: The VPC ID. This parameter is returned when NetworkType is 2
VpcId.description_zh: 专有网络ID，当NetworkType为2时会返回此参数

VswitchId.description_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is returned when NetworkType is 2
VswitchId.description_zh: 虚拟交换机ID，当NetworkType为2时会返回此参数

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the instance list

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of rows displayed per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页最多可显示的行数
